test_title: PYST 6: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Akhil drives a car from his home to office at an average speed of 50 km/h and reaches office 10 minutes early. But one day due to some problem with the car, he could drive at an average speed of 30 km/h only and reached office 10 minutes late. How far is his office from home ?
solution:
**Given:**

If average speed = 50 km/h, then time taken is 10 minutes early than the scheduled time

If average speed = 30 km/h, then time taken is 10 minutes late from the scheduled time

**Concept used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Average speed = Total distance/Total time

If the distance is constant, then

Speed ∝ 1/Time

**Calculation:**

Let the distance be X km, and the scheduled time be T min.

According to the concept,

X = 50 × (T - 10)

also, X = 30 × (T + 10)

Equating the above two equations,

50 × (T - 10) = 30 × (T + 10)

⇒ (T + 10)/(T - 10) = 5/3

⇒ T/10 = 4 = 40

⇒ T = 40 min.

X = 50 × [(40 - 10)/60] = 50 × 1/2

⇒ X = 25 km

**∴ The distance covered by Akhil is 25 km.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**Distance is constant, therefore speed ∝ 1/time

The ratio of average speed = 5 : 3

Ratio of Time = 3 : 5

Difference between the time = 5 - 3 = 2 unit

According to question difference between the time is = T + 10 - (T - 10) = 20 minutes

Here T is the scheduled time

⇒ 2 units = 20 minutes

⇒ 3 units = 30 minutes or 1/2 hr

Akhil takes 30 minutes or half an hour when he drives at 50 km/hr

Distance covered by Akhil = 50 × 1/2 = **25 km**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**In this type of problem, use the direct formula.

Distance (in km) = (S1 × S2)/(S1 - S2) × Time difference (in hrs)

Where, S1 and S2 are the two given average speeds.

S1 = 50 km/h, S2 = 30 km/h, Time difference = 20 minutes = 1/3 hr

⇒ Distance = (50 × 30)/20 × 1/3

⇒ 75/3 = 25 km

**∴ The distance covered by Akhil is 25 km.**
